newsitem.title: CHINA: Southern China ethylene plant begins operation.
newsitem.headline: Southern China ethylene plant begins operation.

text.p: A huge $2.0 billion ethylene plant at Maoming, in China's booming southern province of Guangdong, has started operation, the China Daily said on Tuesday.
The project, which started last Saturday, has 10 large production lines that would produce 300,000 tonnes of ethylene a year, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
The plant is 60 percent owned by China National Petroleum Corp and 40 percent by the Guangdong provincial government and was expected to generate revenues of 1.6 billion yuan a year.
